It is missing '0003-cmake-Dependencies.cmake.patch' entirely, lists sparsehash as '0003-src-third_party-sparsehash-CMakeLists.txt.patch' (actual filename is 0004-...), and lists uuids as '0004-src-uuids.cpp.patch' (actual filename is 0005-...). issues.description: Deliverables table references 'libcassandra.so' (shared library) as the primary artifact, but conanfile.py defaults to static build (default_options = {"shared": False}). issues.description: Hardcoded OpenSSL version string 'set(OPENSSL_VERSION "3.5.6")' in the Conan config discovery path. While this matches the current conanfile.py dependency version (openssl/3.5.6), it will become stale if the openssl dependency version changes in conanfile.py without updating this patch. Consider deriving the version from the Conan target properties instead.

patch_description values do not follow the '序号 描述' (serial-number + description) format convention from code style rules. Examples: 'cmake_minimum_required version upgrade for CMake 4.x compatibility' should ideally start with the patch number like '0001 CMakeLists.txt cmake_minimum_required version upgrade'. All 5 patch_description values follow a free-form English description instead.

patch_generation.source_orig_dir and source_work_dir are both empty strings. While source_orig_hash and source_work_hash are present (1a92c0e26570d13c and 60ecc2eaff17da2e respectively), the empty directory fields may indicate incomplete metadata generation.

All 5 patch_classification entries have guard set to 'pending', indicating that guard detection (whether each patch requires platform-specific #ifdef guards) has not been completed. This is metadata completeness, not a recipe correctness issue.

Duplicate '编译结束' sections with different dates (2026-06-02 12:54 and 2026-08-06 03:36), suggesting notes were partially updated during a re-run without full review of the entire document. This contributed to the stale patch list and version mismatch issues above.

summary:
Audit of cassandra-cpp-driver 2.17.1 Conan recipe (W4 Pre-PR audit re-run). VERDICT: PASS. No P0 (deception) or P1 (correctness) issues found.

Deception detection (all PASS): (1) test_package/test.c calls real API functions — cass_cluster_new(), cass_cluster_free(), cass_session_new(), cass_session_close(), cass_future_wait(), cass_future_free(), and checks CASS_VERSION_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH macros. This is NOT a stub test (R34 satisfied). (2) test_package/conanfile.py has a real test() method that executes the test binary via self.run() — no skip/fake pass (R9 satisfied). (3) manifest.yaml status is 'built' (verified but not uploaded) — honest, no fake 'published' on a failed build. (4) sha256 is a valid 64-character hex string, not all-zeros or all-f's. (5) No #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs in any file (R8 satisfied). (6) No precompiled .so/.a/.o binaries in the PR (R19 satisfied). (7) cassandra-cpp-driver is a database driver, not in the R40 deep-adaptation categories (graphics/UI/multimedia/hardware/system-low-level).

Recipe correctness (all PASS): conandata.yml uses official Apache GitHub source URL with HTTPS and valid sha256. conanfile.py uses Conan 2.x API correctly (from conan import ConanFile, conan.tools.cmake), has proper method order, correct dependencies (libuv/1.52.1, openssl/3.5.6, zlib/1.3.1), appropriate system_libs=['c++'] for static C++ build, and no hardcoded paths. All 5 patches contain genuine portability fixes: cmake_minimum_required upgrades (0001, 0002, 0004), Conan config integration for dependency discovery (0003), manual hash namespace settings for HarmonyOS (0004), and a real type conversion fix (0005). test_package has proper CMakeLists.txt matching cmake_file_name/cmake_target_name, and MANIFEST.yml with upstream_tests and test_package_tests declarations.

Issues found are all P2 (style/warnings) and P3 (hints): conanfile.py has an empty url field matching a forbidden template placeholder pattern; notes.md has hardcoded developer paths, stale patch list (missing 0003, wrong numbering), OpenSSL version mismatch (3.0.13 vs 3.5.6), and references shared lib artifact when recipe defaults to static; patch 0003 hardcodes OpenSSL version string. These should be addressed before merge but do not indicate deception or recipe functional failure.
